title: Quant acceptance runner with golden-replay and delta gates
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a reproducible acceptance runner for quantized model builds that uses a golden-replay methodology: replay a curated 'golden' prompt corpus alongside a sampled production traffic replay (replaybench) to validate FP8/INT8 calibration profiles. The runner should produce a single pass/fail verdict per build plus a structured metrics bundle for triage. Goals: 1) Prevent silent degradation from quantization and calibration sweeps, 2) Provide actionable diffs (per-prompt delta, aggregated semantic regressions, and instruction-following failures), 3) Scale to CI (parallel shards, early-stopping on high-confidence failure). This ticket covers the harness prototype, metric definitions, pass/fail gate implementation, and CI integration. The harness must support: per-layer scale overrides, per-op quant profile selection, adversarial prompt injection, and statistical significance testing (bootstrap CIs) for metric deltas.
acceptance_criteria: Runner can replay a mixed golden + sampled-traffic corpus and emit a metrics bundle (JSON) with token-delta, semantic-similarity, instruction-following rate, and hallucination-rate
Default pass/fail gates: semantic-similarity (BERTScore>=0.915 CI lower bound), instruction-following >=97%, token-count delta <=2.0%
CI integration: any build that fails the gates blocks promotion to canary unless approved via override workflow
Artifacts: stored per-build metrics and a small ranked failure corpus (top 50 worst prompts) in GCS for triage
Performance: end-to-end run time for 5k golden+replay prompts under 45 minutes on the CI quant-test fleet (parallel shards)
test_plan: Create a 3k prompt golden corpus from stable releases (release-1.18 snapshot) with human-validated anchors
Generate a 2k sampled traffic replay from anonymized production logs (privacy-checked) for concurrency/latency checks
Run calibration sweeps: baseline (FP32), FP8 profile A/B, INT8 symmetric/affine for three model families; record metrics and CI intervals
Inject adversarial mutations (paraphrase/noise/OSINT blanks) to measure robustness and ensure gates catch regression modes
Validate runner by intentionally introducing a known regression commit and asserting it fails the gates

decisions: Use BERTScore (vec-based) + instruction-following check as primary semantic regressions; token-delta is secondary but used for latency/cost signal
Default gates tuned conservatively to reduce false positives; team can relax via explicit override during rollout
Run uses stratified bootstrap across prompt-length buckets to stabilize CI for short/long prompts
Adversarial injection enabled by default in nightly runs; disabled for fast PR checks (opt-in)
